items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: I used to know Eddie Marrero and Lawrence Marrero.

ctx.x: Marrero. Phillip Herrera. And she is Sandra Pelabon. Is it on there?
I used to know Eddie Marrero and Lawrence Marrero. Where? Probably some kind of cousin.

I think so. Now this is Barthe and Elispa Pelabon. She was the first queen. She was the first queen. All the rest was mademoiselles. She was the very first queen. Uh huh. Now this is all the same. This is all. I think it's pretty. She made a nice queen. This is Phillip and Joyce bought this. They made a nice queen. Look at Sylvia again. This man died. He died. The one that's driving. He died since. So.
